source_versions_and_licenses._why: Version/build and licence or terms for every source and service, so an auditor can establish which source state produced each retained payload and on what basis retaining it is permitted. A field that genuinely does not exist is recorded as unavailable together with the boundary that follows, not left blank.

PMID:38054408 / DOI:10.1016/j.gim.2023.1.version_or_build: Version of record, Genetics in Medicine 2024;26(3):101036. The retained PubMed record carries a revision date of 2026-05-18; that revision stamp plus the 2026-07-31 access date are the retrieval-version boundary.
PMID:38054408 / DOI:10.1016/j.gim.2023.1.license_or_terms: No reuse licence is stated by the publisher. Scite reports the record as bronze open access, meaning free to read at the publisher without an accompanying open licence.
PMID:38054408 / DOI:10.1016/j.gim.2023.1.retention_basis: Bibliographic metadata only. The publisher abstract and its all-rights-reserved CopyrightInformation are removed, and public author contact emails are redacted. Facts of this kind are not the publisher's copyrightable expression, so retention does not depend on a reuse grant.

PMID:31147632 / DOI:10.1038/s41436-019-0.version_or_build: Version of record, Genet Med. 2019;21(12):2765-2773. No build identifier exists; the 2026-08-03 access date is the retrieval-version boundary.

PMID:31147632 / DOI:10.1038/s41436-019-0.retention_basis: Bibliographic metadata only, with the abstract omitted and affiliation contact emails redacted. Retained solely to document author overlap with the primary source; it supports no claim.

NCBI Entrez / PubMed (service).retention_basis: Bibliographic metadata only, attributed to NLM/PubMed, with the access date preserved as a fixed historical snapshot.

Consensus (service).version_or_build: Unavailable. The MCP interface returns no service version, model version, or index build stamp with a search response, so the 2026-08-03 access date is the only retrieval-version boundary and the result is not reproducible against a pinned index state.

Scite (service).version_or_build: Unavailable. The MCP interface returns no service version or citation-index build stamp, so the recorded citation tallies are a point-in-time reading bounded only by the 2026-08-03 access date and will drift.

The underlying record is separately pinned by PMID and DOI, which are stable, and the author-overlap check rests on those identifiers rather than on the connector.
PubMed MCP connector.license_or_terms: NCBI/NLM public data; no signed licence required, subject to source acknowledgement, non-endorsement, and currentness disclosure. Same NLM terms recorded above for the Entrez route.
